ev.q: Really fun sandbox shooter on Steam Deck
using helicopters, tanks, guns, and active ragdoll physics
Fight as infantry, in armored vehicles, watercraft, or in aircraft
Active ragdoll physics combines tactical strategies with a sprinkle of silly fun
jump straight into massive battles against AI bots
the freedom and replayability make it worth it
I was able to play it with a friend for the past few weeks
pretty fun but lacks some content
combines tactical strategies with a sprinkle of silly fun
simulate D-Day, Omaha, Stalingrad, and a bunch more stuff
